scope: Darboux defect of the actual projected ODE on the stated saved finite-tail RK audit cells, with Fourier decomposition at the largest physical and original-profile-normalized defects found there. A restricted search only identifies the archived full-audit maximum when the reported scalar maxima agree. This is a refinement diagnostic, not a continuous enclosure or closed-surface result.
normalization: Original-profile normalized defect equals abs(Darboux E^2 r r_x / w^2) times shootingParts. Frequency here is physical angular frequency, so retained band is spacing times modes.

stored_metric_adapter.name: tail-original-stored-metric-bounded-points-v1
stored_metric_adapter.scope: Original createRecalibrationFactory(config).assemble() and every original cell retained. Only private point memoization is bounded. No rational deep metric is imported or constructed.

shootingSeamJets.scope: Actual height jets at adjacent integrated ODE pieces on the searched finite stages. The freely adjustable additive height mean is aligned; all nonmean heights and all physical derivatives are compared. Hessian gaps use the operator norm in the common g orthonormal radial/angular frame. These are finite shooting gaps, not a construction of a globally C2 immersion or an infinite collar.

cutFlowVsStoredNode.kind: stored cut node versus integrated cut endpoint
